faq.headline: Fitness Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your fitness website.

items.question: Can members book classes online?
items.answer: A contact form can collect class requests. Live class capacity and bookings require a working bookings module.

items.question: Can I sell memberships?
items.answer: You can explain membership options. Recurring customer payments need a supported, enabled subscription and payment flow.

items.question: Can I show a timetable?
items.answer: Yes. Publish class times and update them as your schedule changes.

items.question: What should I include in a class timetable?
items.answer: List class names, times, duration, level, location, and what to bring. Keep the schedule current and explain how visitors can ask about a place.

items.question: Can beginners find a suitable class?
items.answer: Describe the experience level and format of each class, and explain how a new member can contact the coach with questions before attending.

items.question: Can I show trainer qualifications?
items.answer: Yes. Add accurate qualifications and training experience, and use staff photos only with permission. Avoid promising specific health or fitness outcomes.
